doc: Config of the planted toy (tests_m2/test_extract_go_toy.py). Same format as spec/M2/lib/go_frontend.json. The package toy.local/fixture/prim is in no document, so its ToWord is a call outside the analyzed packages whose semantics this config declares (a to_array primitive of width 4).

toy.local/fixture/prim.ToWord.text: ToWord(b) is the 4-byte array holding b right-aligned; for len(b) == 4 element k is b[k].
